text:
emily (CEO): Quick weekly — short and tactical. Two big themes this week: Private GA readiness and tightening our launch safety posture. TL;DR: focus on KMS/HSM, EU data residency, canary rollback hygiene, and one small policy change on log retention. Please read and call out blockers by EOD Wed.

emily (CEO): Private GA checklist (top-line asks)
• KMS/HSM integration end-to-end (dev + ops + security): validate envelope keys + key rotate runbook by Thu EOD. @marco please confirm HSM test window.
• EU data residency: finish infra routing for eu-region pinning and prove no cross-region telemetry by Sat. @ravi @sasha
• Audit & logging: delivery of searchable, redacted audit logs to customer buckets (SLA: 7d ingest) — finish schema + retention policy.

emily (CEO): Launch safety / risk appetite
• Canary thresholds: p95 latency < 150ms, error rate < 1.0%, no unhandled model mismatch errors. If any threshold breaks for >5m, automated rollback to hosted variant.
• Fallback policy: make sure traffic routing rule exists that upgrades to Hosted-Standard if Dedicated pool capacity < 20% for >3m.

emily (CEO): Metrics snapshot (last 7d):
• Platform requests +4.8% w/w, embeddings +9% (growth skewed to batch jobs)
• p95 gen latency: 122ms (target 110ms) — tail still sticky on long-seqlen jobs
• API error rate: 0.9% (target <0.8%) — most errors are model timeouts during spikes
• Cost per 1k gen tokens: down 6% after batching changes — good work team

emily (CEO): Small policy update (effective immediately): default retention for internal request logs moves from 90 -> 180 days. Why: gives SRE/troubleshooting more runway for regressions tied to versioned models. This is internal default only; customer-facing exports unchanged. @sasha update docs/ACLs.

emily (CEO): Primary asks (who does what)
• @marco (Security Lead) — confirm KMS/HSM test results and provide a short runbook for emergency key rotation by Thu.
• @ravi (VP Eng) — provide a one-pager on routing rules & canary automation by Wed COB. Include the exact fallback trigger config.
• @jordan (VP Product) — coordinate customer comms plan for Private GA and a short Q&A for sales by Fri.
• @lisa (PMM) — prepare the GA launch checklist content and the in-product flag copy.
• @sasha (Head of Ops) — update incident playbook for cross-region failover and validate the new log retention change in staging.

ravi (VP Eng): Noted. I'll sync with infra owners this afternoon. Quick heads up: long-seqlen tail is being driven by a small set of customers running 8k+ contexts; we have a mitigations RFC to reduce KV churn — will attach.

marco (Security Lead): KMS test window confirmed Thurs 09:00–11:00 UTC. HSM vendor certs in staging look good. Emergency rotate runbook draft ready, will drop in the ops channel after testing.

jordan (VP Product): I'll own customer-facing comms. Lisa and I will pair on the FAQ. Can we lock the final messaging tomorrow morning?

lisa (PMM): Yup. I'll draft the GA email + release notes. Want to include simple diagram for network isolation.

sasha (Head of Ops): I'll update the internal playbooks and the retention config in staging today. Ops will run the canary smoke at 16:00 UTC and report back.

deploy-bot: canary-rollout private-ga v1.3 -> 5% traffic at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z :ear_of_rice:
deploy-bot: canary health check: p95=118ms, errors=0.7%, no model-mismatch alerts, rollout stable at 5%

emily (CEO): Thanks — appreciate the speedy responses. If anyone hits a blocker that affects the checklist items above, @me and specify ETA. Will do a short bridge Thu morning if any item is late.

ravi (VP Eng): Will flag immediately if HSM tests show any cert expiry issues.

marco (Security Lead): noted. Also flag: final KMS audit needs sign-off from legal — looping in now.

emily (CEO): Good. Small ask to all leads — please keep updates to 1–2 lines in the thread so we can scan before Thurs bridge. Short updates only.

lisa (PMM): Understood. Draft ready by 09:30 tomorrow and I'll post here.

sasha (Head of Ops): Ops smoke complete. No regression on staging; retention config applied.

deploy-bot: canary-rollout update: bumped to 10% at 2026-03-23T16:20:00Z, health ok.

emily (CEO): Excellent. Closing the loop for now — thanks team. Will post a recap after Thurs bridge. :white_check_mark:
